mechanism_and_counterevidence: Other-traveller age/cryo attributes and group/cabin population are absent from the individual13-column row; this changes available information rather than optimizing LR on the same information.
Conditional unanimity is a heuristic, not a physical invariance. Destination/Deck may differ within groups; currently unanimous observed members do not prove a missing member has that value.
Only PeerCryoSleepRate/PeerKnownCryoCount/PeerMeanAge explicitly exclude the row itself. GroupChildren includes self and counts known Age<13; missing ages count0, so it is a known-child lower bound.

SurnameCount spans multiple PassengerId groups. Several joint group summaries can fingerprint families even without rawID/Name. Random-fold improvement alone can be optimistic; whole-group validation is essential.

Related aggregate columns add redundancy and missingness under a synthetic pretraining prior. More features can harm attention/preprocessing; historical Cat/HGB negatives warrant a cheap fixed falsification, not presumed gain.

label_free_coverage.interpretation: Coverage only, not a score or evidence of residual predictive signal.

roster_and_split_contract.GroupCV: Alldevelopment GroupIds remain disjoint between fit-target support and validation-target queries. Unlabelled attributes of a withheld group remain available. Call this transductive group validation, not fully inductive unseen-roster evaluation.
roster_and_split_contract.test_roster: Train/test GroupIds do not intersect, but same-group test peers and cross-group surname counts still use the complete known roster. No test target exists or is read.
